cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(EnduranceLibhv LANGUAGES C CXX)

# The original project only carried libhv headers. Build the matching 1.3.3
# TCP/event implementation from source with the same compiler/runtime as ENDURANCE.
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
include(cmake/utils.cmake)

check_header("stdbool.h")
check_header("stdint.h")
check_header("stdatomic.h")
check_header("sys/types.h")
check_header("sys/stat.h")
check_header("sys/time.h")
check_header("fcntl.h")
check_header("pthread.h")
check_header("endian.h")
check_header("sys/endian.h")

set(hv_saved_required_libraries "${CMAKE_REQUIRED_LIBRARIES}")
set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_LIBRARIES Threads::Threads)
check_function("gettid" "unistd.h")
check_function("strlcpy" "string.h")
check_function("strlcat" "string.h")
check_function("clock_gettime" "time.h")
check_function("gettimeofday" "sys/time.h")
check_function("pthread_spin_lock" "pthread.h")
check_function("pthread_mutex_timedlock" "pthread.h")
check_function("sem_timedwait" "semaphore.h")
check_function("pipe" "unistd.h")
check_function("socketpair" "sys/socket.h")
check_function("eventfd" "sys/eventfd.h")
check_function("setproctitle" "unistd.h")
set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_LIBRARIES "${hv_saved_required_libraries}")

# TCP transport needs neither TLS nor optional HTTP/protocol/KCP modules.
set(WITH_OPENSSL OFF)
set(WITH_GNUTLS OFF)
set(WITH_MBEDTLS OFF)
set(ENABLE_UDS OFF)
set(USE_MULTIMAP OFF)
set(WITH_KCP OFF)
set(WITH_WEPOLL ${WIN32})
configure_file(hconfig.h.in "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/hconfig.h" @ONLY)

set(hv_source_dirs base ssl event util cpputil evpp)
if(WIN32)
    list(APPEND hv_source_dirs event/wepoll)
endif()
set(hv_sources)
set(hv_include_dirs "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
foreach(hv_dir IN LISTS hv_source_dirs)
    file(GLOB hv_dir_sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${hv_dir}/*.c"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${hv_dir}/*.cpp")
    list(APPEND hv_sources ${hv_dir_sources})
    list(APPEND hv_include_dirs "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${hv_dir}")
endforeach()
list(FILTER hv_sources EXCLUDE REGEX "_test\\.(c|cpp)$")

add_library(hv_static STATIC ${hv_sources})
target_include_directories(hv_static PUBLIC ${hv_include_dirs})
target_compile_definitions(hv_static PUBLIC HV_STATICLIB)
set_target_properties(hv_static PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
target_link_libraries(hv_static PUBLIC Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
if(WIN32)
    target_compile_definitions(hv_static PRIVATE
        WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS _WIN32_WINNT=0x0600)
    target_link_libraries(hv_static PUBLIC secur32 crypt32 winmm iphlpapi ws2_32)
else()
    target_link_libraries(hv_static PUBLIC m)
    if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
        target_link_libraries(hv_static PUBLIC rt)
    endif()
endif()
